verification_attempts.evidence: Confirmed current permissive repository licenses and canonical upstream paths for the reachable GitHub sources before reclassification.
The repository API has no licenseInfo, but both tracked upstream SKILL.md files explicitly declare MIT; the skill-level license is the copy authority.
The repository is currently unavailable; the previously confirmed MIT skill is retained as a local-only snapshot and is not eligible for automatic replacement.

The only upstream change adds a CONTRIBUTING.md link and does not alter reusable DevOps operating guidance, install behavior, safety controls, or compatibility; the curated local skill remains unchanged and the reviewed checkpoint advances.

Absorbed durable React and Next.js corrections for Chromium support, router back behavior, Suspense shared-element readiness, default-none semantics, silent share failures, nested transitions, and displacement morphs; synchronized the complete upstream reference set.

Canonical body already equals upstream and the tracked SKILL.md path has not changed since commit 805687f34e8c10b420e3d11335a0ca2c3c90d992; advanced the repository and path checkpoints without rewriting content.
